description: This file contains functions related to launching text editors within a Git environment, including getting environment-specific editor settings, launching editors with specified files, and handling interactive editing of buffers.

methods.name: int is_terminal_dumb(void)
methods.description: Checks if the terminal is considered 'dumb' based on the TERM environment variable.

methods.name: const char * git_editor(void)
methods.description: Determines the appropriate text editor to use based on environment variables and defaults.

methods.name: const char * git_sequence_editor(void)
methods.description: Determines the sequence editor setting, falling back to the standard editor or repository configuration.

methods.name: int launch_specified_editor(const char * editor,const char * path,struct strbuf * buffer,const char * const * env)
methods.description: Launches a specified editor for a given file path, handling process management and reading back the file if needed.

methods.name: int launch_editor(const char * path,struct strbuf * buffer,const char * const * env)
methods.description: Launches the configured editor for a specific file path.

methods.name: int launch_sequence_editor(const char * path,struct strbuf * buffer,const char * const * env)
methods.description: Launches the sequence editor configured for Git operations.

methods.name: int strbuf_edit_interactively(struct repository * r,struct strbuf * buffer,const char * path,const char * const * env)
methods.description: Allows editing a string buffer interactively by writing it to a temporary file, launching an editor, then reading the changes back.
